firstAppearance.note: Year of the original game; not the release year of the Remake model depicted in this package.

galleryDescription.en: Cheerful on the outside and more reserved within, Tifa values the people close to her but often keeps her worries to herself. Cloud's childhood friend and the proprietor of Seventh Heaven, she supports Avalanche while facing her own doubts. A skilled martial artist, she fights with agile punches, kicks and flowing combinations.
galleryDescription.zhCN: 蒂法待人开朗，内心却较为含蓄，珍视身边的人，也常把烦恼留给自己。她是克劳德的青梅竹马，在米德加经营第七天堂酒吧，并作为雪崩的一员面对自己的疑虑与抉择。身为格斗家，她以敏捷的拳脚和流畅的连击迎战。

combatStyle.en: Zangan-style martial arts; agile punches, kicks and combinations.
combatStyle.zhCN: 赞甘流格斗术，擅长敏捷的拳脚与连击。
